nodes.label: authorization.py
nodes.description: check_authorization(request) — verifies user, purpose, object, role and tool authorization at execution time; denies by default on stale/ambiguous entitlement (fail-closed).

nodes.label: evidence_resolver.py
nodes.description: verify_integrity, check_unit_conversion, surface_contradiction(states), resolve_identity — reconciles conflicting source states without silently normalizing them.

nodes.label: knowledge_gateway.py
nodes.description: resolve_citation(doc) — resolves a knowledge citation only after checking document status/authority, refusing untrusted/superseded/draft sources as authoritative.

nodes.label: model_registry.py
nodes.description: verify_model_integrity(model) — model supply-chain integrity check (hash/version) before a model result can be trusted.

nodes.label: tool_gateway.py
nodes.description: invoke_tool(call) — bounded, validated tool invocation gateway; replaces the legacy_portal.js executeTool() pattern that called any tool with any payload.

nodes.label: Workflow A: batch_evidence.py
nodes.description: assemble_batch_response(request) — GxP batch evidence completeness/conflict/gap review. Detectors: _detect_genealogy_break, _detect_sterility_excursion, _detect_unit_conversion_defect, _detect_ebr_back_entry_during_downtime, _detect_pat_model_drift, _detect_qp_evidence_gap. Never releases/rejects/reprocesses/relabels/recalls a batch.

nodes.label: Workflow B: pv_intake.py
nodes.description: assemble_pv_response(request) — pharmacovigilance case intake and signal support. Detectors: _detect_reporting_clock_conflict, _detect_meddra_version_mismatch, _detect_expectedness_source_conflict, _detect_sensitive_segment_gap, _detect_social_media_authenticity_gap, _detect_product_quality_safety_link, _detect_signal_disproportionality_instability. Never decides seriousness/causality/expectedness/reportability/signal.

nodes.label: Workflow C: supply_options.py
nodes.description: assemble_supply_response(request) — non-executing supply/cold-chain recovery options. Detectors: _detect_serialization_aggregation_break, _detect_counterfeit_suspicion, _detect_customs_documentation_mismatch, _detect_cold_chain_lane_excursion, _detect_critical_excipient_shortage, _detect_cmo_capacity_conflict, _detect_allocation_ethics_gap, _detect_recall_scope_uncertainty. Never reserves/allocates/changes quality status/ships/initiates a recall.

nodes.label: Workflow D (planned): clinical_trial_context.py
nodes.description: Additional scope, built and tested, not yet included in this release. Never renders eligibility, treatment_arm or endpoint_conclusion. TypeScript port exists at submission/app-advanced/lib/workflows/clinical_trial_context.ts, page excluded from routing at app/_roadmap-workflow-d/.

nodes.label: Workflow E (planned): discovery_translational_science.py

flows.name: Workflow A request lifecycle (GxP batch review)
flows.description: A request for object evidence, checked, assembled and validated — ending in mandatory human review, never a batch disposition.

flows.name: Workflow B request lifecycle (pharmacovigilance)
flows.description: Case intake, duplicate-candidate surfacing, contract validation, ending in mandatory human review, never a final PV decision.

flows.name: Workflow C request lifecycle (supply/cold-chain)
flows.description: Non-executing recovery-option assembly with quarantine exclusion and counterfeit/customs/aggregation detectors, ending in mandatory human review with no_side_effects:true.

flows.name: Authorization deny path
flows.description: A request with a stale or inactive entitlement is denied by check_authorization; execution_status is not_executed and no further workflow processing occurs.

flows.name: Evaluation / proof-of-testing flow
flows.description: Deterministic and adversarial tests assert prohibited-action boundaries; the evaluation harness runs scenarios through graders and writes reports and machine-readable evidence.

flows.name: Knowledge authority gate (poisoned-trap defense)
flows.description: A workflow's citation request is resolved only after knowledge_gateway checks document status/authority, rejecting untrusted (poisoned), superseded, or draft sources even if lexically relevant.

flows.name: App scoping roadmap (Workflow D/E not yet shipped)
flows.description: Workflow D and E implementations exist and are tested identically to A/B/C, but app-advanced excludes their pages from routing in this release; only the roadmap page and library files reference them.
